subtopic: RESTful Resource Modeling and HTTP Semantics
question_text: Which HTTP method is defined by RFC 9110 as idempotent but NOT safe?
answer_explanation: PUT is idempotent (multiple identical requests result in the same server resource state) but not safe (it alters server state). GET/HEAD are both safe and idempotent.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: C. Rationale: PUT is idempotent (multiple identical requests result in the same server resource state) but not safe (it alters server state). GET/HEAD are both safe and idempotent.
